subject: Vendor onboarding: PO workflow, timeline & line-item format for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Elaine Torres <elaine@acmecloud.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-06-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: vendor onboarding & PO requirements (Acme Cloud)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this — Acme Cloud is excited to get Redwood set up as a vendor so we can proceed with the integration work next month. To keep things moving, could you confirm a few procurement items so we can complete our side of the onboarding form (attached):

- Do you require a specific vendor portal (e.g., Coupa) or is a vendor record in your internal system sufficient?
- Is a purchase order required before the first invoice, or can we invoice and then receive a PO?
- Typical PO issuance lead time once vendor paperwork is complete?
- Any preferred line-item structure for your AP system (GL code, SKU, deliverable dates, unit price vs milestone)?

We’ve attached our vendor onboarding form (vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx). If you have a PO template or a checklist that will speed approvals, please send it over. We are aiming to have first-day access and billing in place by July 1 — any way to expedite would be appreciated.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx

Best,
Elaine Torres
Vendor Ops | Acme Cloud Solutions
elaine@acmecloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding & PO requirements (Acme Cloud)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear note and for sending the form. Looping in Marissa (procurement) and Neha (finance) to help with the vendor record and PO timing; Dev is on contracts. Quick answers below and next steps at the bottom.

Summary answers:
- Vendor portal: We prefer vendors be created in our procurement portal (Coupa). If you cannot access Coupa, we can create the vendor from your completed onboarding form, but that adds one extra step for vendor verification.
- PO requirement: For services where the monthly spend is expected to exceed $5,000, a PO is required prior to the first invoice. For smaller or one-off purchases, we can accept an invoice and retroactively issue a PO within 5 business days, but that requires finance approval.
- PO lead time: Once the vendor record is created and compliance docs are received, a standard PO is issued within 2–3 business days. If you need expedited processing (48 hours), please flag that and provide a sample invoice + a copy of the signed SOW.
- Line-item structure: Preferred fields are: description, quantity, unit price, total, deliverable date (if applicable), Redwood account_code/GL (we’ll supply), and a short SKU or reference. For milestone billing, include explicit milestone names and acceptance criteria so our AP team can match invoices easily.

Please see attached: Redwood PO template (redwood_po_template.pdf) and our onboarding checklist (vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx). Action items:
1) Elaine: Please return the completed onboarding form and a sample invoice/P.O. from your side. If you want expedited PO, include a short note on that request.
2) Marissa: Please create the vendor record in Coupa after you receive Elaine’s completed form and vendor W-9.
3) Dev: Please review the SOW in advance; let us know if any contract language requires redlines that will delay PO issuance.

If useful, we can host a 20-minute call to walk through the documentation tomorrow.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_po_template.pdf]
[Attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx]

From: Elaine Torres <elaine@acmecloud.com>

Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding & PO requirements (Acme Cloud)

Thanks Vivek — that helps. We filled out the onboarding form and attached a sample invoice for reference. A couple of follow-ups:

- We can register in Coupa if you send an invite; otherwise the filled form + W-9 is fine to create the vendor record on your side.
- We’d prefer the PO before the first invoice but understand your $5k threshold. Our initial SOW is for $12k so we request a PO before invoicing. Can you confirm if you can fast-track that?
- Do you accept POs via email (PDF) or should POs be issued through Coupa only?

We’ve attached: vendor_setup_filled.xlsx, sample_invoice.pdf. If a 48-hour turnaround is possible for the PO, we can align our go-live to that window.

Thanks,
Elaine
[Attachment: vendor_setup_filled.xlsx]
[Attachment: sample_invoice.pdf]

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding & PO requirements (Acme Cloud)

Hi all — quick update and confirmed next steps.

- Coupa invite: Marissa will send a Coupa vendor invite this afternoon so Acme can self-register (preferred). Marissa, please confirm when the invite is out.
- Expedited PO: We can expedite issuance to a 48-hour window once Marissa confirms the vendor record and Neha confirms the W-9/tax docs. Elaine, we are flagging this as expedited for the finance queue.
- PO delivery: We issue POs from Coupa by default but will accept a signed PO PDF by email only for expedited cases; final PO will still be recorded in Coupa for audit.
- Line items: For your $12k SOW, please use the single invoice with three line items (setup, integration milestone, ongoing monthly fee) and include milestone acceptance criteria on the invoice (this matches our AP matching rules).

Action owners & links:
- Marissa Cole: Create vendor in Coupa and send invite (https://hubspot.company/contacts/companies/98721)
- Neha Kapoor: Quick tax-doc check (W-9) and finance clearance
- Dev Patel: Review SOW for any legal blockers

Elaine — once you confirm you received the Coupa invite (or if you prefer we create the vendor from your form), we’ll target PO issuance within 48 hours.

Thanks — Vivek
